projects.name: NEXUS
projects.tagline: A spatial operating system for the browser
projects.description: Ten holographic modules orbiting the viewer in a volumetric room with no walls. Hand tracking as the primary input, a streaming Gemini assistant that drives the interface through the same API your hands do, and replies that assemble from particles in mid-air. Built in three phases: environment, assistant, real data.

prompts.text: Build a production-quality futuristic spatial computing web application called NEXUS. Not a dashboard. Not a website. It should feel like an operating system.
Turn NEXUS into an AI assistant. Use Gemini API. All communication must stream. Wake phrase Nexus or circle gesture. Support interruption.
Every module becomes real. No placeholders.

projects.name: banana-claude
projects.tagline: Claude Code plugin for Gemini image generation
projects.description: A Claude Code plugin that turns Claude into a creative director for Google's Nano Banana image models. Interprets intent, selects domain expertise, constructs optimised prompts and orchestrates the API. Ships as a marketplace plugin with zero pip dependencies.
